notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Muldrotha enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.
